prompt: Generate: a side-view 2D game background for a quiet hub room between boss fights. The place: an old moonlit sanctuary at night inside an abandoned temple, calm and mysterious. The camera looks straight at the far wall from the side at standing eye level, with no tilt. A flat stone floor runs across the whole bottom fifth of the image, edge to edge; its back edge is one straight horizontal line one fifth of the way up from the bottom. On the floor stand three identical empty, waist-high stone pedestals, evenly spaced: one at a quarter of the image width, one in the exact center, one at three quarters. Behind them: a tall stone wall with three tall arched alcoves, one behind each pedestal, cool blue moonlight falling through a high round window, a few lit candles on the floor at the base of the wall, hanging ivy. Nothing on top of the pedestals. Modern high-fantasy TV anime cel style: crisp dark line art with slight weight variation (thicker outer contour, thinner interior lines), two-tone cel shading with sharp-edged shadow shapes, one small hard highlight on metal, saturated but controlled colors in clean flat fills, consistent light from the upper left. Painted as anime background art for a cel-shaded game: clean shapes, sharp-edged cel shadows, softer and lower-contrast values than the characters that will stand in front of it, slightly hazier toward the top. No characters, no people, no creatures, no text, no watermark, no user interface.
note: Lobby: a moonlit sanctuary with three pedestals for the relics
